1. #! /usr/bin/env node
2. 
3. import { createReadStream } from 'fs'
4. import * as readline from 'node:readline/promises'
5. 
6. import log from 'loglevel'
7. import logPrefix from 'loglevel-plugin-prefix'
8. import { Command } from 'commander'
9. 
10. import { WACZ } from '../index.js'
11. import { PACKAGE_INFO, LOGGING_COLORS } from '../constants.js'
12. 
13. const program = new Command()
14. 
15. /**
16.  * Program info
17.  * @type {Command}
18.  */
19. program
20.   .name(PACKAGE_INFO.name)
21.   .description(PACKAGE_INFO.description)
22.   .version(PACKAGE_INFO.version, '-v, --version')
23. 
24. /**
25.  * `create` command
26.  * @type {Command}
27.  */
28. program.command('create')
29.   .description('Creates a .wacz file out of one or multiple .warc or .warc.gz files.')
30.   .option(
31.     '-f --file <string>',
32.     'Path to .warc / .warc.gz file(s) to process. Wrap in quotation marks if glob.')
33.   .option(
34.     '-o --output <string>',
35.     'Path to output .wacz file.', 'archive.wacz')
36.   .option(
37.     '-p --pages <string>',
38.     'Path to a jsonl files to be used to replace pages.jsonl. ' +
39.     'If not provided, js-wacz will attempt to detect pages.')
40.   .option(
41.     '--url <string>',
42.     'If provided, will be used as the "main page url" in datapackage.json.')
43.   .option(
44.     '--ts <string>',
45.     'If provided, will be used as the "main page date" in datapackage.json.')
46.   .option(
47.     '--title <string>',
48.     'If provided, will be used as the collection title.')
49.   .option(
50.     '--desc <string>',
51.     'If provided, will be used as the collection description.')
52.   .option(
53.     '--signing-url <string>',
54.     'URL of an authsign-compatible server to be used to cryptographically sign the archive. ' +
55.     'See https://github.com/webrecorder/authsign.')
56.   .option(
57.     '--signing-token <string>',
58.     'Required if the server at --signing-url requires an authentication token.')
59.   .option(
60.     '--log-level <string>',
61.     'Can be "silent", "trace", "debug", "info", "warn", "error"', 'info')
62.   .action(async (name, options, command) => {
63.     /** @type {Object} */
64.     const values = options._optionValues
65. 
66.     /** @type {?WACZ} */
67.     let archive = null
68. 
69.     // Set log output level and formatting
70.     logPrefix.reg(log)
71.     logPrefix.apply(log, {
72.       format (level, _name, timestamp) {
73.         const timestampColor = LOGGING_COLORS.DEFAULT
74.         const msgColor = LOGGING_COLORS[level.toUpperCase()]
75.         return `${timestampColor(`[${timestamp}]`)} ${msgColor(level)}`
76.       }
77.     })
78. 
79.     if (values?.logLevel) {
80.       let level = 'info'
81. 
82.       if (['silent', 'trace', 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'].includes(values.logLevel)) {
83.         level = values.logLevel
84.       }
85. 
86.       log.setLevel(level)
87.       log.info(`Log output level as been set to ${level}.`)
88.     }
89. 
90.     // `--file` is mandatory
91.     if (!values?.file) {
92.       console.error('Error: --file not provided.')
93.       return
94.     }
95. 
96.     // Pass options to WACZ
97.     try {
98.       archive = new WACZ({
99.         input: values.file,
100.         output: values?.output,
101.         url: values?.url,
102.         ts: values?.ts,
103.         title: values?.title,
104.         description: values?.desc,
105.         signingUrl: values?.signingUrl,
106.         signingToken: values?.signingToken,
107.         log
108.       })
109.     } catch (err) {
110.       log.error(`${err}`) // Show simplified report
111.       return
112.     }
113. 
114.     // Ingest user-provided pages.jsonl file, if any.
115.     if (values?.pages) {
116.       try {
117.         log.info(`pages.jsonl: Reading entries from ${values?.pages}`)
118.         const rl = readline.createInterface({ input: createReadStream(values.pages) })
119. 
120.         for await (const line of rl) {
121.           const page = JSON.parse(line)
122. 
123.           if (!page?.url) {
124.             continue
125.           }
126. 
127.           log.info(`Adding ${page.url}.`)
128.           archive.addPage(page?.url, page?.title, page?.ts)
129.         }
130.       } catch (err) {
131.         log.trace(err)
132.         log.error('An error occurred while processing user-provided pages.jsonl.')
133.       }
134.     }
135. 
136.     // Main process
137.     try {
138.       await archive.process()
139.       log.info(`WACZ file ready: ${values.output}`)
140.     } catch (err) {
141.       log.error(err)
142.       log.error('WACZ could not be processed.')
143.     }
144.   })
145. 
146. program.parse()
147.
